decisions.reason: As a multi-item aloe vera facial care line with dedicated presentation in both 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's core natural-skincare knowledge and gives strong scope to learn, refine, and commercialize within existing capabilities.

The hyaluronic acid serum remains on the website across both years and is close enough to the firm's established facial-care formulation know-how that management would likely retain it, though competition and its more standard single-product format raise some risk.

The cleansing oil is a recent launch and therefore less proven, but it is highly related to the firm's existing cleansing and natural-care expertise, so a small German producer with in-house development would usually keep it long enough to absorb market feedback and improve it.
